text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, dammit! It's not healing at all!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What the heck... Isn't putting on toner 
supposed to fix rough skin...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tch... If I keep this up, I'll embarrass 
not just myself, but everyone around me...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, geez! It's all about quantity right 
now! I'm gonna slather on tons of it!!

Jungle Pocket seemed concerned about it, 
but her skin troubles persisted 
nonetheless.
